ValidationRule.description: IM-47: The Initiative should not be populated if Foundation code type is not Parent or Budgeted or Miscellaneous Initiative or Focus Area Misc
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( AND( NOT( ISPICKVAL( Type__c , 'Parent Initiative') ) , NOT( ISPICKVAL( Type__c , 'Budgeted Initiative') ), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Type__c , 'Miscellaneous Initiative')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Type__c , 'Focus Area Misc')) ) , NOT(ISBLANK(Initiative__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Initiative cannot be set for this foundation code type.
